|translation='''Title:''' Sunset.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on a planet system. Locations in that system become nighttime. In battles there, each side may add only one destiny draw. Spies may deploy at nighttime locations at no cost.

'''Lore:''' When Tatooine's two suns set, Sand People and other threats close in and battle becomes more dangerous. On Hoth, the temperature drops to extremes.
